host_instrumentation.scope: Opt-in same-host monotonic spans; compiler/seed/build decisions remain the archived source.

scope: Completed baseline and diagnostics, no compiler optimization or default enablement. Bootstrap uses emitted bump targets via Node; native matrix uses emitted RC1 targets and separate CPU processes, not a native thread pool.

bootstrap_method_proof.scope: Driver fixes after the completed run affect clock setup and the not-yet-run matrix. Every function that measures or verifies bootstrap is AST-identical to the executed snapshot; old snapshot is retained.

harness.diagnostic_change_after_completed_run: Only adds refusal when the validation artifact differs from measured stage1. Both actual entry products already match. Snapshot is the resumed parent/worker/memory/startup/validation/summarize driver; ordinary profiles completed before a parent-only VIBE_LOWERING_DIRECTORY launcher fix, with ordinary() unchanged. Failed parent logs remain in parent-profiles-failed-directory and are excluded from accepted results.

host_instrumentation.scope: Opt-in same-host monotonic spans; compiler/seed/build decisions remain the archived source.

bootstrap.protocol: Serial; compiler then portable CLI, reversed in alternate rounds. Cold removes only this isolated checkout's merge-tool image/stamp and starts a fresh guest cache; warm reuses both. Outputs are always regenerated. Node processes/JIT are fresh; OS page cache is warm. Packaging, installation and native runner compilation are excluded. Host spans and end-of-run memory counters are enabled; no CPU profiling.
bootstrap.memory: Simultaneous process-tree RSS sampled every20ms; shared pages can be double-counted. Per-process first/last observations are bounds, not exact lifetimes. Guest bump frontier/allocation/committed memory are retained in logs, not inferred from RSS.

native_matrix.protocol: Native JIT primed on a different input; fresh guest cache per round/variant, cold followed by warm in new processes. Forward/reverse/forward order; equal-length lane and cache paths. o0/a0 are A/A controls; s0 is the same-driver serial reference; p1/p2/p4 are whole public native frontend builds. Target RC1; parent/worker engines bump, coordinator RC. Checked-module/body/final-artifact caches off. RSS sampled every20ms; shared mappings may be double-counted. No concurrent builds/profiles.

small_input_startup.interpretation: Complete small-input startup with native cache cold/warm and guest cache cold in both. The difference is net JIT/cache benefit, not isolated engine-instantiation time or a large-build speedup.

profile_scope: 36 separate CPU profiles: 3 actual flat compiles, 3 ordinary FS CLI compiles, 3 native parent profiles per corpus, 3 per each of 4 captured worker slots per corpus. V8 self/inclusive weights include host/GC/idle; native epoch samples exclude host work. Inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed. No profiled elapsed time enters promotion walltime.

memory.scope: Context prefix is a wire-size breakdown. Parent and worker counters are diagnostic controls; guest bump frontier, reserved pages and allocation volume are separate from simultaneous matrix RSS. Do not sum independent per-process peaks.

validation_probe.scope: Diagnostic seed compiles of copied flat input. Portable CLI requires main-entry validation before reuse. A match supports investigating receipt-bound reuse; it does not implement or prove freshness/publication safety.

promotion_budgets.sampling: At least 3 alternating cold/warm pairs, min/max and medians. Below5% inconclusive; increase N if spread or paired directions obscure decision.
promotion_budgets.status: Proposed reviewable promotion policy; not an enforced timing CI gate and not a claim that current workers pass.

ranked_next_actions.action: Receipt-bound reuse of a successful seed validation product as stage1, with entry-aware validation for portable CLI.
ranked_next_actions.maximum_whole_build_benefit: One 43.8–44.6s validation compile per pipeline: approximately18–22% compiler and22–29% portable CLI of baseline. This is an upper bound before receipt checks and publication cost; never remove validation or the sticky-failure guard.
ranked_next_actions.proof: Copied flat source compiles to exact measured stage1 bytes with cli_main and main independently. Current validator always requests cli_main.

ranked_next_actions.action: Profile-guided actual-flat checker lookup indexing; investigate V8 GC separately before changing memory growth policy.
ranked_next_actions.maximum_whole_build_benefit: env_lookup_binding has17.70% self samples per current-compiler flat compile. Proportional cost model: eliminating all its work bounds savings at~16s across compiler bootstrap stage1-to2 and stage2-to3,~8s across portable CLI stage1-to2, before replacement cost. The seed runs validation and stage0-to1 and was not CPU-profiled; extending this percentage to those calls is not justified. These are sample-based ceilings for demonstrated current-compiler calls, not measured walltime wins.
ranked_next_actions.proof: Three named, executable-section-identical profiles. Effect lowering is12.42% inclusive and body emission only1.06% on actual flat selfcompile, unlike the FS CLI corpus.

ranked_next_actions.action: Reduce large literal-pool replication/decoding and retained snapshot buffers with canonical indices preserved.
ranked_next_actions.maximum_whole_build_benefit: Current p4 complete worker interval is0.918s compiler /2.433s FS CLI warm. Eliminating that entire interval is an impossible best-case ceiling, not a transfer-only estimate. Bootstrap benefit is zero until the route is integrated. CLI shared context50,067,552 bytes; pool38,983,105 wire bytes.
ranked_next_actions.proof: Exact real-build job captures, 3 repeated native profiles per slot, separate guest frontier/reserved accounting. CLI context decoding consumes24.66–34.07% of worker guest samples, by slot median.

ranked_next_actions.action: Bounded native CPU threads with separate Stores, then actual bump-target selfbuild integration3485 and promotion3486.
ranked_next_actions.maximum_whole_build_benefit: Function workers cannot bypass serial preparation. Even replacing the full p4 worker interval with zero only bounds the current FS pipeline; it does not remove preparation or finalization. Actual flat body emission is~1.06% inclusive guest ancestry in V8 samples, which does not justify expecting a whole-build15% win from that guest work alone. GC/host costs have separate ancestry; any indirect gain needs measurement. A larger safe parallel boundary may be necessary; existing build-unit issues2507/2826/2508 own that alternative.

raw_retention.policy: Large CPU profiles, complete logs, generation receipts and sampled per-process observations remain in this local ignored workspace. This committed record retains all102 timed samples, their hashes, memory controls and diagnostic attribution. Raw files can be checked against the manifest; CPU samples are diagnostics only.
